game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Characteristics and limits
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Case 9: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Characteristics and limits.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Counter Conveyor' (Week 4 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Bone Crypt'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave

source_player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from slime blobs in Bone Crypt: keep the belt_count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: belt_count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Bone Crypt Defense
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
